stage_impacts.proposed_change: Inventory both source revisions, client/protocol, service identity, independent migrations and the existing CI access failure.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Inventory distinguishes current manual export from proposed relay/inbox and records both deployments.

stage_impacts.stage_name: Canonical semantic type and Cog contracts
stage_impacts.proposed_change: Keep selected sealed semantic releases authoritative; define typed message projections through the existing catalog.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: A valid receipt or mutable external Type response cannot bypass sealed-release validation.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Bind the local causal event to its approved projection, stable UUID and independently checked Syn receipt.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Reject wrong workspace/installation, mismatched payload or cause, and receipt-as-authorization claims.

stage_impacts.stage_name: Build matrix and stage acceptance harness
stage_impacts.proposed_change: Add exact-revision two-service contract/migration lanes while retaining ordinary offline stage gates.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Missing private source access is blocked, not passed; no mandatory database/sandbox gate is skipped.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Keep MCP stdio and supervised process ownership; route normalized admitted lifecycle events to the common publisher.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Syn outages cannot authorize a new process or replay an MCP side effect.

stage_impacts.existing_prerequisites: T02.1,T01.3; security design review before remote calls
stage_impacts.proposed_change: Keep MCP HTTP/OAuth audience checks distinct from Syn workspace token authentication.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: A Syn message cannot spoof an admitted MCP callback, session or grant.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Retain qualified process isolation and existing worker identity; export only approved bounded event metadata.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: No raw environment, private console stream or host permission is propagated through Syn.

stage_impacts.stage_name: HTTP, SDK, GraphQL and gRPC adapters
stage_impacts.proposed_change: Use the canonical Syn client for receipt transport while preserving the existing generic API adapters and effect classifications.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Transport retry appends an identical message only; it cannot replay the original API operation.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Extend disclosure and incoming-message policy using existing task/actor grants.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Workspace token and sender/channel fields cannot grant per-user or execution authority.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Pin permitted service destinations/identity and retain worker egress and sandbox enforcement.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Unexpected endpoint changes, redirects and private-network access outside approved scope are denied.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Broker recipient/workspace-scoped Syn credentials; include them in redaction and rotation rules.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: No Syn token reaches prompts, receipts, artifacts or untrusted worker environments.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Add atomic local outbox intent, fenced relay acknowledgement and deduplicating admitted inbox using existing durable primitives.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Crash before/after remote append causes neither lost required delivery nor duplicate admitted external execution.

stage_impacts.stage_name: Curated registry and trusted package catalog
stage_impacts.proposed_change: Treat shared catalog records as attributed candidates and retain the pending plugin-discovery strategy.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: No receipt, publisher statement or shared descriptor silently installs or trusts a package.

stage_impacts.stage_name: MCP discovery, rescan and schema reconciliation
stage_impacts.proposed_change: Use messages as change hints, then revalidate the admitted installation and exact catalog revision.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Forged, stale or replayed hints cannot silently refresh or revoke an unrelated workspace catalog.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Preserve ownership-neutral ranking and source independence; shared receipts add provenance rather than ranking authority.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Copied observations do not become independent corroboration or an unexplained trust/quality bonus.

stage_impacts.stage_name: Versioning, health, revocation and install lifecycle
stage_impacts.proposed_change: Apply lifecycle changes through existing installed-instance ownership, not directly from shared messages.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Remote revoke/update hints require checked scope/revision and cannot mutate active runs by themselves.

stage_impacts.stage_name: Search provider adapters and result normalization
stage_impacts.proposed_change: Retain provider disclosure/budget policy; share only approved search observation references.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: No query is sent to Syn or a provider without the applicable disclosure decision.

stage_impacts.stage_name: Fetch, extraction and canonical source artifacts
stage_impacts.proposed_change: Keep private source artifacts outside append-only messages and classify every exported digest/reference.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Receipt storage neither proves original-byte capture nor overrides retention and reference permissions.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Keep source dates, corrections and provider identity distinct from the transport record.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: A Syn storage timestamp is not a source publication date or independent source confirmation.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Preserve source-group independence and unresolved contradictions when sharing evidence.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Repeated delivery or copied chain entries cannot multiply corroborating source counts.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Keep browser session ownership and controls; use the common admitted event publisher.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: No browser profile, cookies or interaction permission is exported as message authority.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Retain session-bound debugger/trace handling; export redacted references only.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Raw network tokens or another session trace cannot enter workspace-wide Syn messages.

stage_impacts.stage_name: Visual regression, accessibility and desktop fallback
stage_impacts.proposed_change: Keep screenshots and accessibility evidence in the authorized artifact store.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: A receipt is not evidence of visual display or successful user interaction.

stage_impacts.stage_name: Browser reliability benchmark and test fixtures
stage_impacts.proposed_change: Preserve independent browser fixture scores; record delivery overhead separately.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: A messaging retry cannot rerun a form submission or inflate browser success.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Distinguish connector/CLI permissions, private source access, push receipts and PR/CI state.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Successful branch push does not imply workflow access or completed verification.

stage_impacts.stage_name: Local Git, AST and LSP intelligence
stage_impacts.proposed_change: Bind source snapshots and dependencies to the exact Syn gitlink and approved source visibility.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: A changed/unavailable submodule invalidates the corresponding reproducibility claim.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Qualify the selected Potbot/Syn/client migration tuple and private-submodule CI route.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Checkout failures remain blocked qualification; application checks must actually execute.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Preserve exact-state PR/CI closure and add dependency PR/pin/check evidence.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: A valid anchor or local test cannot override failing mandatory exact-head CI.

stage_impacts.stage_name: Safe SQL and analytical data adapters
stage_impacts.proposed_change: Retain separate database/schema roles and migration owners for Potbot and Syn.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Syn bearer access cannot bypass Potbot RLS or expose internal SQL/query authority.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Keep named vector spaces, eligibility, graph semantics and exact coverage under existing retrieval owners.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Shared delivery cannot restore deleted content or turn receipt order into graph support.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Pin the Syn protocol contract and selected compatibility tuple as an explicit service dependency.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Unsupported service/schema versions fail explicitly without silently changing payload meaning.

stage_impacts.stage_name: Cloud, files, collaboration and optional services
stage_impacts.proposed_change: Keep connector-scoped credentials and route-specific reconciliation; messages carry only admitted references.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: No communication acknowledgement implies success of a cloud/collaboration mutation.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Retain compute implementation and independent recomputation; optionally anchor approved output receipts.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: A stored hash cannot replace numerical tolerance or reproducibility checks.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Keep solver outcome semantics and counterexample evidence unchanged.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Timeout/unknown remains unknown even when its receipt is acknowledged.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Keep backend cost/units/provider evidence independent of Syn delivery.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: A chain receipt cannot establish provider model revision or mathematical correctness.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Retain independent kernel/model-checker acceptance; use receipts only for provenance.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Tamper evidence never substitutes for a valid checked proof or correct assumptions.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Compile typed communication steps with explicit local admission and immutable parent/input lineage.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Received messages cannot introduce an ungranted action or unbounded workflow edge.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Keep one durable scheduler; add fenced message delivery/inbox integration after security gates.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Lost acknowledgements, duplicate inbox delivery and Syn outage do not double-dispatch or fabricate child completion.

stage_impacts.stage_name: Model reasoning controller and independent critics
stage_impacts.proposed_change: Keep model/critic authority and accounting separate from remote claimed results.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Cross-agent output remains evidence to validate; an acknowledged proposal cannot approve itself.

stage_impacts.stage_name: Adaptive selection, caching and capability utility
stage_impacts.existing_prerequisites: T10.3; offline utility fixture (expanded by T11.1)
stage_impacts.proposed_change: Use only accepted, scope-correct observations for routing/utility updates.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Shared receipts do not automatically promote performance claims, caches or learned policy.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Add a separate two-service fixture family without changing model-quality or task-success cohorts.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Message persistence, author trust and actual task quality are scored separately.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Verify local causation plus receipt identity/chain against retained external anchors.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Reject wrong-installation receipts, truncated prefixes and claims that an internally consistent rewritten head proves truth.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Measure delivery latency/backlog/recovery independently from task quality and provider spend.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: No model quality improvement is claimed from messaging fixtures or synthetic receipt chains.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Add outage, rotation, forged sender, replay/fork, restore, disclosure and deletion fault cases.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: No unauthorized cross-workspace action or private-data resurrection succeeds in the gated corpus.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Bring dependency-specific source access, install and compatibility checks forward into foundation qualification.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Fresh authorized clone resolves the exact gitlink; unsupported/inaccessible service is explicit, and offline contracts remain available.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Expose execution and delivery state separately with both cursor domains and anchor status.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: API/UI never label stored or acknowledged data as authorized, executed or factually verified solely due to Syn.

stage_impacts.stage_name: Developer docs, SDK, examples and migration guides
stage_impacts.proposed_change: Document the two-service contract, privacy/retention, credential boundary, upgrades and failure recovery.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Examples distinguish current manual sync from proposed relay/inbox and resolve source/media references.

stage_impacts.proposed_change: Release a qualified source/client/protocol/service/DB compatibility profile with restore/rollback evidence.
stage_impacts.additional_acceptance: Neither repository is called integration-qualified until its mandatory exact-revision gates pass.
